spec.title: Stage A: how much margin does each manipulator constraint need on its own under +/- 2 % tolerance?
spec.hypothesis: Pre-registered 2026-10-24 before any run. Criterion: a margin meets the robustness criterion for a constraint when, for every one of the 10 seeds, the 95 % Wilson upper bound of that constraint's failure rate over 1,000 independent +/- 2 % uniform perturbations of the run's best design is at most 5 %. Predictions: reach is guaranteed (not just sampled) from a 2 % reach margin, because the shortest perturbed chain is 0.98 (L1 + L2); the sampled threshold may be lower because the joint corner is rare. Tip deflection scales roughly as L^3 / r^4, so a box guarantee would need about 13-14 %, and the sampled threshold is expected well below that. Each sweep tightens only its own constraint (margin 0 elsewhere), so the other constraint is expected to keep failing; overall robustness is assessed in stage B. Same optimiser, budget and seeds as robust-formulations-manipulator, so nominal, uniform-3 and uniform-7 should reproduce that study's designs exactly.
